section_summary.extract_value: This section reports that body image flexibility was measured using the 12-item Body Image-Acceptance and Action Questionnaire (BI-AAQ), with items rated from 1 (Never true) to 7 (Always true) and scores computed as the mean of reverse-coded items so higher scores indicate greater flexibility. It also notes reliability in the present study ("Cronbach's a for this scale was .95 in women and men") but provides no sample, demographic, BMI, or assessment-of-body-appreciation details.
section_summary.evidence_source: Key sentences: "To measure body image flexibility, we used the 12-item Body Image-Acceptance and Action Questionnaire (BI-AAQ; Sandoz et al., 2013)." and "In the present study, Cronbach's a for this scale was .95 in women and men."
